panels.title: AG Replicas

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT r.server_id, r.server_name, r.collection_time, r.ag_name, r.replica_server_name,
           r.role_desc, r.is_local, r.operational_state_desc, r.connected_state_desc,
           r.recovery_health_desc, r.synchronization_health_desc, r.availability_mode_desc,
           r.failover_mode_desc, r.endpoint_url
    FROM collect.ag_replica_states AS r
    JOIN (
        SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) AS max_collection_time
        FROM collect.ag_replica_states
        GROUP BY server_id
    ) AS latest
      ON r.server_id = latest.server_id
      AND r.collection_time = latest.max_collection_time
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    latest.ag_name AS "AG",
    latest.replica_server_name AS "Replica",
    CASE WHEN latest.is_local THEN 'Yes' WHEN latest.is_local = false THEN 'No' ELSE '—' END AS "Local",
    latest.role_desc AS "Role",
    latest.operational_state_desc AS "Operational State",
    latest.connected_state_desc AS "Connected State",
    latest.recovery_health_desc AS "Recovery Health",
    latest.synchronization_health_desc AS "Sync Health",
    latest.availability_mode_desc AS "Availability Mode",
    latest.failover_mode_desc AS "Failover Mode",
    latest.endpoint_url AS "Endpoint URL",
    CASE GREATEST(
        CASE UPPER(latest.synchronization_health_desc)
            WHEN 'HEALTHY' THEN 1 WHEN 'PARTIALLY_HEALTHY' THEN 2
            WHEN 'NOT_HEALTHY' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END,
        CASE UPPER(latest.connected_state_desc)
            WHEN 'CONNECTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'DISCONNECTED' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END,
        CASE UPPER(latest.operational_state_desc)
            WHEN 'ONLINE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 2 WHEN 'PENDING_FAILOVER' THEN 2
            WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN 3 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 3 WHEN 'FAILED_NO_QUORUM' THEN 3
            ELSE 0 END,
        CASE UPPER(latest.recovery_health_desc)
            WHEN 'ONLINE' THEN 1 WHEN 'ONLINE_IN_PROGRESS' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
        CASE UPPER(latest.role_desc)
            WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 1 WHEN 'SECONDARY' THEN 1 WHEN 'RESOLVING' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
    )
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Severity",
    latest.collection_time AS "Collected"
FROM latest
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = latest.server_id
WHERE latest.server_id IN (${server:csv})
  AND (${ag:sqlstring} = '*' OR ${ag:sqlstring} = '' OR UPPER(latest.ag_name) = UPPER(${ag:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY latest.ag_name, srv.name, latest.replica_server_name

panels.description: Latest snapshot per reporting server, not the dashboard time range. One row per (reporting server, AG, replica) - a replica with multiple monitored reporters appears once per reporter, since each reports a different perspective.

panels.title: AG Database Replica States

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT d.server_id, d.server_name, d.collection_time, d.ag_name, d.database_name,
           d.replica_server_name, d.is_local, d.synchronization_state_desc,
           d.log_send_queue_size, d.redo_queue_size, d.log_send_rate, d.redo_rate,
           d.is_suspended, d.suspend_reason_desc, d.availability_mode_desc,
           d.secondary_lag_seconds
    FROM collect.ag_database_replica_states AS d
    JOIN (
        SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) AS max_collection_time
        FROM collect.ag_database_replica_states
        GROUP BY server_id
    ) AS latest
      ON d.server_id = latest.server_id
      AND d.collection_time = latest.max_collection_time
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    latest.ag_name AS "AG",
    latest.database_name AS "Database",
    latest.replica_server_name AS "Replica",
    CASE WHEN latest.is_local THEN 'Yes' WHEN latest.is_local = false THEN 'No' ELSE '—' END AS "Local",
    latest.synchronization_state_desc AS "Sync State",
    latest.availability_mode_desc AS "Availability Mode",
    latest.log_send_queue_size AS "Send Queue (KB)",
    latest.redo_queue_size AS "Redo Queue (KB)",
    latest.log_send_rate AS "Send Rate (KB/s)",
    latest.redo_rate AS "Redo Rate (KB/s)",
    latest.secondary_lag_seconds AS "Lag (s)",
    CASE
        WHEN latest.log_send_queue_size IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN latest.log_send_queue_size <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN latest.log_send_rate IS NULL OR latest.log_send_rate <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE round((latest.log_send_queue_size::numeric / latest.log_send_rate) / 60.0, 2)
    END
        AS "Est Send Drain (min)",
    CASE
        WHEN latest.redo_queue_size IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN latest.redo_queue_size <= 0 THEN 0
        WHEN latest.redo_rate IS NULL OR latest.redo_rate <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE round((latest.redo_queue_size::numeric / latest.redo_rate) / 60.0, 2)
    END
        AS "Est Redo Drain (min)",
    CASE WHEN latest.is_suspended THEN 'Yes' WHEN latest.is_suspended = false THEN 'No' ELSE '—' END AS "Suspended",
    latest.suspend_reason_desc AS "Suspend Reason",
    CASE
        WHEN latest.is_suspended THEN
            CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(latest.suspend_reason_desc), '') IS NULL THEN 'Suspended'
                 ELSE 'Suspended: ' || latest.suspend_reason_desc END
        WHEN latest.is_suspended = false THEN 'Moving'
        ELSE '—'
    END AS "Data Movement",
    CASE CASE
        WHEN latest.is_suspended THEN 3
        WHEN UPPER(latest.synchronization_state_desc) = 'SYNCHRONIZED' THEN 1
        WHEN UPPER(latest.synchronization_state_desc) = 'SYNCHRONIZING' THEN
            CASE WHEN UPPER(latest.availability_mode_desc) = 'ASYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT' THEN 1
                 ELSE 2 END
        WHEN UPPER(latest.synchronization_state_desc) = 'NOT SYNCHRONIZING' THEN 3
        WHEN UPPER(latest.synchronization_state_desc) IN ('REVERTING', 'INITIALIZING') THEN 2
        ELSE 0
    END
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Sync Severity",
    latest.collection_time AS "Collected"
FROM latest
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = latest.server_id
WHERE latest.server_id IN (${server:csv})
  AND (${ag:sqlstring} = '*' OR ${ag:sqlstring} = '' OR UPPER(latest.ag_name) = UPPER(${ag:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY latest.ag_name, srv.name, latest.database_name, latest.replica_server_name

panels.description: Latest snapshot per reporting server. While suspended, the queue and drain estimates freeze rather than grow - Suspended/Data Movement carry that context, so a frozen-looking row is not necessarily caught up.
